generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders Shall not be under declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.

All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner. ( section 3 & 4 of the bid document ) and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Tenderer . Necessary Certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents Section can be used for this purpose.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Vijayapur during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned.
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
All Item rates are Exclusicve of GST.
The Increase in G.S.T shall not be paid in the extended period of Contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
Work Completion/Execution Period is 11 months including Monsoon.

To qualify for the award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years financial years. 2021-22 to 2025-26. (b) satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as prime contractor at-least one similar work such as maintenance/Improvement/Renewal of asphalt road work of value not less than Rs. 29.06 Lakhs.
Difference amount should submit at the time of Agreement.
The Contractor should maintain the Road in good condition till end tender period.

The tenderer shall furnish ,as part of his tender,EMD in the amount as shown in column 4 of the table of IFT for this particular work.The E.M.D. Rs. 1,16,300/- shall be paid in full through E-payment or in two parts part (1)Rs.50,000/- BY E-PAYMENT. Part (2) balance EMD of Rs.66,300/- EMD shall be in favour of Executive Engineer, Public Works Department Vijayapur Division Vijayapur. And should be in the form of Bank Guarantee in the Prescribed format obtained from any Nationalized / Scheduled Bank. The Part(2) of the EMD shall be delivered to the Executive Engineer before the prescribed date and time of opening of the Technical Bids. Earnest Money Deposit/ Bid security.

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of RS.58.13 Lakhs (not less than the estimated cost under this contract).
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
including cost of all materials, labor ,HOM,l & UL, curing with all leads and lifts etc. complete as per specifications & as directed by Engineer-in-charge of the work.

The Bidder,at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site of Works and its surroundings including source of earth, water, road aggregates, availability of labor etc.and obtain all information that may be necessary for preparing the Bid and entering into a contract for undertaking the maintenance Works. The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense.

The Contractor shall maintain the Road Assets in proper condition that comply with the Road Maintenance Standards and ensure users safety and comfort. The maintenance activities shall be so planned that the defects are repaired well before they reach maximum condition asper the permissible tolerance. After issuing the work order the contractor should complete 25% of the work every month. (Contractor Should Complete the pothole filling within 2 months of workorder issued)
If the contractor has not done the maintenance work satisfactorily in previous years such bids will be rejected.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 24/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employ.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, Dated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.
As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 Tenderer not ready to make aggrement, Hence the tenderer EMD amount is forfeited and tender is rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.
Supply of tools and plants (spade, pic axe, pan, sickle) required for maintenance work is to be provided by the Tendrer.
Contractor should visit the site and should give certificate that he will maintain the road pot hole free up to the end of tender Period.
Activity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Do not Consider the Technical Criteria from SL No 1 to 10

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual maintenance for Bharkhed Bilagi State Highway 124 Road from km 249.75 to 264.25,km 265.75 to 284.31,km 284.48 to 284.55, and km 289.50 to 301.15

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with B type Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. 
 ---- Charges with all lead and lift including other incidental charges wherever necessary for successful completion of work and as directed by the Engineer in charge of work.
